simple: Unified management of secrets in the AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault, Google Secret Manager and HashiCorp Vault cloud stores. Discovers all vaults and secrets, their owners, unmanaged vaults, unused secrets and missed rotations; syncs secrets with Idira (both ways for AWS, Azure and Google), with Idira handling rotation and lifecycle — developers do not need to change their code. Applies the same access, rotation and expiry policies across all vaults and prepares audit reports. Licensed as a base pack plus packs by the number of sync targets.
